annotations.title: Attach a photo link to a flood observation

description:
Attach a photo to a flood observation as a reference LINK (never a file).

MCP never uploads photo bytes. A local path, file:// URL or data: URI is
refused: to upload a photo file, open the observation in the map and use the
photo strip on its form (JPEG, PNG or HEIC, 25 MB, 10 per observation).
The link counts toward the 10.

caption.description: What the photo shows (optional, up to 500 characters)

credit.description: Who took it / the rights holder (optional)

public_consent.description: Show this photo to visitors of a public project (default false: members only)

reference_url.description: An http(s) link to the photo (stored, never fetched)
